Where the revenue comes from. Revenue by collection is stacked by period, a column at a time; the
path from a visit to an order shows each step as a share of the one before; channels and cities
are ranked bars with their values written out.

<Template name="analytics" />

## Try it

- Hover or focus a column: the tooltip lists the three collections in that period.
- Change the period: the columns go from days to weeks to months.

## Details that matter

- **Three collections, three colors,** chosen together and checked so they can be told apart with
  every common kind of color blindness, in both themes.
- **A 2px gap between stacked segments,** not a border: the gap separates them without adding ink.
- **The drop-off is the story of a funnel,** so each step says what share of the step before made
  it.
